items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if A -> B is a ring map with Tor^A_i(B, B) = 0 for i > 0 and L_{B/B tensor_A B} = 0, then L_{B/A} = 0 in D(B) (source lines 1804-1809). The proof computes the base change of L_{B/A} along B -> B tensor_A B via the flat base change lemma, then uses the distinguished triangle associated to B -> B tensor_A B -> B together with the vanishing of L_{B/B} (from the polynomial algebra case) and of L_{B/B tensor_A B} (the hypothesis) to obtain a chain of equalities showing that the derived tensor product of L_{B/A} with the tensor square and then with B over the square is zero, and this composite is just L_{B/A}.
